reviewer: stream_sota independent source and artifact review
coverage_unchanged: Every complete record calls the original unmodified audit_unequal.audit_record: all RNG blocks, predictable actions, allocations, first certified stops and original full Decimal certificates.
incremental_integrity: Only newline-complete records advance the offset and prefix hash.
A partial trailing line is reread from the unadvanced offset.
Expected record identity set, final byte length and complete ledger digest must match exactly.
Parsed summary bytes, exact spec, audit sources and run sources are hash-bound and rechecked at completion.
operational_limits: A process restart does not resume existing audit progress automatically.
Hard deadline is checked between complete record audits; a running original audit_record call is nonpreemptive.
claim_boundary: Implementation and data-flow audit, not independent theoretical or full-field SOTA verification. Frozen normalizer primitives are reused. No prospective observation generated by this review.
